title: The Effects of GeoGebra On Third Grade Primary Students’ Academic Achievement in Fractions
venue: International Electronic Journal of Mathematics Education
intervention: GeoGebra dynamic representational activities for teaching fractions

title: The Effect of Using Storytelling Strategy on Students’ Performance in Fractions
intervention: Teaching fractions using target-focused storytelling with picture stories
comparison: Teaching fractions using manipulative materials (objects, area models, number lines)

title: Impact of multiple representations-based instruction on basic six pupils’ performance in solving problems on common fractions
venue: Journal of Mathematics and Science Teacher
intervention: Multiple representations-based instruction (paper folding, number line, symbols, verbal)
comparison: Conventional lecture/discussion instruction on common fractions
outcome: 10-item common fraction problem-solving test (post-test, out of 30)

title: How robust are learners’ misconceptions of fraction magnitude? An intervention study comparing the use of refutation and expository text
intervention: Refutation text explicitly refuting fraction magnitude misconception
comparison: Expository text explaining fractions without addressing misconception
outcome: Accuracy on computerized fraction magnitude comparison test

title: Fostering German-language learners’ constructions of meanings for fractions—design and effects of a language- and mathematics-integrated intervention
design: quasi-experimental pre-test post-test control group design with random assignment to matched pairs
intervention: Language- and mathematics-integrated intervention relating registers, pushed output, and scaffolding for fractions
comparison: Regular classroom instruction with usual fraction textbook repetition program
outcome: Standardised fraction test (41 items) post-test score

title: The impact of different approaches to the teaching of Grade 5 fraction by three experienced teachers
venue: South African Journal of Childhood Education
intervention: Teacher Ben's approach using multiple representations (concrete-to-semi-concrete-to-symbolic) and learner-centered activities for addition of fractions
comparison: Teacher Will's approach using teacher-led demonstrations with limited representation connections
outcome: Fraction Achievement Test (FAT) post-test score on addition of fractions

title: Making Conceptual Knowledge Connections to Clear Misconceptions in Fractions in Primary Classrooms
venue: IOSR Journal of Research & Method in Education (IOSRJRME)
intervention: Multiple representations based instructional program using manipulatives, pictures, and problem solving for fractions
comparison: Conventional/traditional fraction instruction taught discretely without connecting representations
outcome: Fraction concepts test (pre-test and post-test scores)

title: The effect of gamification on young mathematics learners’ achievements and attitudes
venue: Journal of Educational Technology and Online Learning
intervention: Gamified fraction instruction using Pyramidal Design Model elements (progress map, badges, avatars)
comparison: Standard non-gamified fraction instruction following the same curriculum
outcome: Teacher-developed 24-item academic achievement test on fractions

title: Impact of worked-out examples via a Web 2.0 tool on fifth graders achievement, attitudes, and motivation in mathematics
intervention: Worked-out examples with multiple solution methods delivered via Nearpod Web 2.0 tool
comparison: Textbook-based activities delivered via Nearpod with single solution method

title: Error-based Activity Applications in Sixth Grade Fraction Teaching
intervention: Error-based activity (EBA) fraction instruction using incorrect and correct solutions with discussion
comparison: Standard mathematics curriculum instruction without error-based activities
outcome: Subject Comprehension Test (SCT) fraction achievement post-test
